## Summary

Describe the change and the user problem it addresses.

## Validation

- [ ] `python -m unittest discover -s tests -v`
- [ ] `node --check web/app.js`
- [ ] Manually tested the changed user flow, if applicable

## Checklist

- [ ] Documentation is updated where needed.
- [ ] No generated audio, virtual environments, personal documents, or credentials are included.
- [ ] Offline behavior remains independent of network services.
- [ ] Privacy and supported-platform behavior are described accurately.
